scenes.title: Title Card
scenes.narration: Welcome to our lesson on photosynthesis. Let's explore how plants make their food.
scenes.caption: Visual: A simple drawing of a plant with leaves and a sun.

scenes.title: Concept Diagram
scenes.narration: Photosynthesis is like a recipe. Plants use sunlight, water, and carbon dioxide to make their food.
scenes.caption: Visual: A diagram showing sunlight, water, carbon dioxide, and glucose (food) in a cycle.

scenes.title: Process Flow
scenes.narration: First, plants absorb sunlight through their leaves. Then, they take in water from the soil and carbon dioxide from the air.
scenes.caption: Visual: A flowchart showing the steps of photosynthesis.

visual_data.steps:
1. Absorb sunlight
2. Take in water and carbon dioxide

scenes.title: Caption
scenes.narration: Finally, plants combine these ingredients to make glucose, which they use for energy and growth. This process also produces oxygen, which is good for us.
scenes.caption: Visual: A simple illustration of glucose and oxygen production.

visual_data.caption: Photosynthesis: Sunlight, Water, Carbon Dioxide â Glucose, Oxygen
